sn35.76:1.2: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.76:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamattako ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || || 4
sn35.76:1.4: Yaṃ kho Rādha aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || || 5-7
sn35.76:1.5: Kiñca Rādha aniccaṃ || || Cakkhuṃ kho Rādha aniccam || tatra te chando pahātabbo || ||
sn35.76:1.8: Yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccam tatra te chando pahatabbo || la || || 8-9
sn35.76:1.11: Mano anicco tatra te chando pahātabbo ||
sn35.76:1.15: Yampidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi aniccaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo || 11
